a new obligation class or partner document adds a required item
audit records show an item is never failing, which usually means it is not being tested

base.update_signal: the trace of cancellations and complaints back to specific gate items, showing which checks actually prevent loss and which are theatre

edges.why_related: the ledger exists to satisfy the charter's rule that every shown quantity trace to a captured artifact
the consumption baseline is only defensible if the bills or data export behind it are captured and dated
the rate schedule is read against this household's actual consumption pattern, not in the abstract
export compensation is defined relative to the rate schedule and to which charges survive netting
the forward-load interview adjusts a baseline that must already exist before it can be adjusted
plane dimensions, photographs and deduction notes are ledger artifacts before they are model inputs
shade is quantified per candidate plane, so the planes must be segmented first
measured per-plane shade is a required model input and carries its own uncertainty into the output
sizing trades production per plane against consumption and export value, which requires the model first
the value of surplus generation under the applicable class is what makes an increment of array worth building
the bill comparison can only be built once the array being compared is fixed
escalation cases are variations applied to a comparison that must already be tariff-faithful
which disclosures must accompany each financing class comes from the obligation classes identified in the frame
the third-party-ownership walk-through only makes sense once the household knows what ownership class it sits in
what the service equipment requires determines which interconnection and permit path the project will take
the gate audits an assembled pack; there is nothing to audit until the pack exists
the charter's permitted-source rule constrains what the savings model is allowed to assert and forbids guarantee framing
the obligation classes dictate which notices must be in the pack and how the contract may be delivered
service and busbar capacity caps what can be interconnected without an upgrade and therefore bounds the size
a roof that should be replaced first, or planes the installer will not attach to, remove area from the sizing decision
the gate's first item is traceability, which fails whenever the ledger is incomplete
the comprehension restatement and the no-pressure condition are gate items that can stop a signature outright
an error in per-plane shade propagates through modeled production straight into the monthly saving the household is shown
counting an aspirational load as committed directly produces an oversized array the household pays for
what is known about the stage queues determines the timeline language the pack is allowed to carry
the assumption that an incentive will be received is exactly what triggers or avoids a loan's payment re-amortization
the financing conversation follows a fixed system scope, so the household compares structures rather than moving targets
the re-roof decision must be settled and written down before the pre-signature audit can pass its site-risk item
each gate stop reveals which artifact the ledger routinely fails to capture and tightens the capture list
utility and inspector corrections on real projects teach which service conditions the early screen keeps missing
monitored output compared against the model retunes which shade method is trusted for which kind of site
the questions households ask about the pack expose claim types the charter has not yet ruled on
a larger array pays the seller more while the charter's verified-numbers rule often points at a smaller, consumption-matched system
edges.resolution_rule: the charter wins: the recommended size is the one the export class, the usable area and the committed load support, and any larger option may only be presented as a separately labelled alternative with its weaker surplus value shown

edges.why_related: a compounding utility-escalation assumption inflates lifetime savings far beyond anything the tariff-faithful first-year model supports
edges.resolution_rule: no lifetime figure may be shown without the zero-escalation case beside it and the source of the escalation assumption named; where they disagree, the first-year tariff-faithful figure is the headline

edges.why_related: a complete disclosure pack is long enough that volume itself can defeat the comprehension the care protocol requires
edges.resolution_rule: comprehension wins: the plain-language summary and the restatement check govern, and any term the household cannot restate is re-explained before signature no matter how fully it is documented in the pack

edges.why_related: the measured history and the household's declared future consumption point at different baselines and therefore different systems
edges.resolution_rule: the measured history is the base case and only documented commitments may move it; declared intentions appear solely as a labelled sensitivity the household chooses to act on or not

edges.why_related: netting an incentive into the price makes the model far more attractive but converts a conditional entitlement into an asserted certainty
edges.resolution_rule: the model is built without the incentive and any incentive is shown separately as a conditional line with its claiming party, authority and adviser referral attached

edges.why_related: both are scripted term-by-term disclosure walks over a long-duration obligation document, sharing the same structure of payment, term, transfer and end-of-term questions

conflict_axes.name: commission_size_versus_right_size
conflict_axes.description: Every increment of array raises the commission on the deal while the export-compensation regime and the household's real consumption may make that increment worth little to the household.
poles: build the largest array the roof allows
size to consumption and export value
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state the offset target and the binding constraint in writing; present a larger option only as a labelled alternative whose surplus is valued at the applicable export rate

conflict_axes.name: speed_to_signature_versus_verified_inputs
conflict_axes.description: The one-visit close is the highest-converting sales pattern in this vertical and is also incompatible with waiting for a full year of usage data and a measured shade study.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: let a proposal be presented on provisional inputs only if every provisional input is labelled and the signature waits for the verified version

conflict_axes.name: modeled_precision_versus_appointment_cost
conflict_axes.description: Instrument shade measurement, plane-by-plane survey and a tariff-faithful model cost hours per household in a business where most appointments never sign.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: spend measurement effort where the estimate is most sensitive — shade and tariff — and label remote-modeled inputs as such rather than upgrading their confidence for free

conflict_axes.name: optimistic_escalation_versus_defensible_baseline
conflict_axes.description: Lifetime savings figures are dominated by the assumed utility escalation rate, which no seller can forecast but every competitor uses.
poles: show only what the tariff supports
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: lead with the first-year tariff-faithful figure, show any escalating case only beside a zero-escalation case, and name the source of the assumption

conflict_axes.name: disclosure_completeness_versus_comprehension
conflict_axes.description: Everything material must be disclosed, yet a pack long enough to contain everything is a pack a household will not read.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: put obligations and uncertainties before the savings figure, carry the burden in a plain-language summary, and gate on the household restating the terms in their own words

conflict_axes.name: third_party_ownership_access_versus_long_term_complexity
conflict_axes.description: Lease and power-purchase structures open solar to households with no cash and no tax appetite, and they also concentrate this industry's long-tail regret in escalators, buyouts and transfer at sale.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: walk the full term script before price, require restatement of escalator and transfer-at-sale, and treat inability to restate as a stop rather than an objection

conflict_axes.name: incentive_dependent_pricing_versus_program_risk
conflict_axes.description: Pricing and loan payment structures that assume an incentive look far better and fail badly for households that cannot use it or for deals that miss a program deadline.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: model without the incentive, show it as a conditional line with its authority and claiming party, and show the loan payment at both the incentive-applied and incentive-not-applied levels

conflict_axes.name: install_now_versus_reroof_first
conflict_axes.description: An aging roof under a new array creates a future removal-and-reinstall cost, while raising it delays or kills a deal the seller is paid on only if it proceeds.
poles: install on the roof as it is
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: put the trade to the household with the roofer's quote and the installer's removal-and-reinstall pricing, and record their decision rather than making it for them

conflict_axes.name: installer_deference_versus_early_warning
conflict_axes.description: Structural, electrical and code determinations belong to the installer, yet a household that learns of a service upgrade only at the installer's site audit experiences it as a bait and switch by the seller.
poles: stay silent until the installer determines
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state possibilities and decision paths with installer-sourced pricing while explicitly reserving the determination to the installer's electrician or engineer

conflict_axes.name: confident_timeline_versus_honest_range
conflict_axes.description: Households comparing proposals reward the seller who names a switch-on date, and no seller controls the interconnection, permit and inspection queues that decide it.
poles: quote a date to win the comparison
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: give staged ranges with the current blocking stage named and the installation-versus-authorization distinction in writing, and never quote a date the installer has not committed to

edge_cases.description: The household supplies one summer bill and refuses to authorize a utility data download, but wants a proposal at the same visit
edge_cases.trigger: incomplete consumption history combined with pressure to produce a number immediately
edge_cases.mitigation: produce a clearly provisional estimate with the single-bill basis labelled on every page that uses it, and make the verified version a condition of signature rather than a follow-up

edge_cases.description: The export-compensation regime changes between the proposal and the interconnection application, moving the deal onto different terms
edge_cases.trigger: a regulator or utility implements a new export class with a cutover date while the deal is open
edge_cases.mitigation: re-read the applicable class, re-model, re-issue the proposal with the change explained, and state the cutover as a sourced fact without turning it into a countdown used as pressure

edge_cases.description: A neighbour's fast-growing trees or a vacant lot zoned for a taller building will shade the array within the term
edge_cases.trigger: future shade that no current measurement captures
edge_cases.mitigation: write the future-shade risk into the proposal, model a shaded sensitivity case, and make no claim about rights to light or the neighbour's future behaviour

edge_cases.description: The service panel cannot accept the interconnection as it stands, so an upgrade or an alternative connection method is required after a price was already discussed
edge_cases.trigger: busbar or breaker rating discovered at the installer's site audit rather than at the seller's screen
edge_cases.mitigation: screen and photograph the panel at the first visit, disclose the upgrade possibility with its decision path in the original proposal, and re-issue rather than treat it as a change order

edge_cases.description: The roof covering has only a few years of life left and the household wants to install now anyway
edge_cases.trigger: aging covering combined with a household focused on the monthly payment
edge_cases.mitigation: present the re-roof-now versus remove-and-reinstall-later trade with the roofer's quote and the installer's reinstall pricing, record the household's decision in writing, and never make the decision for them

edge_cases.description: Only one of two owners is present, or the property is held in a trust or by an estate, and the person at the table wants to sign
edge_cases.trigger: a signatory who may not have authority over the property or the obligation
edge_cases.mitigation: stop and reschedule with all owners or the authorized party present, and refer questions about who may sign for a trust or estate to the household's own adviser

edge_cases.description: The household negotiates in a language the rep does not speak and offers a child or a neighbour as interpreter
edge_cases.trigger: a language barrier during a decades-long financial commitment
edge_cases.mitigation: arrange a competent independent interpreter and materials in the language of negotiation, verify any language-delivery obligation class for the jurisdiction, and decline to proceed on an improvised translation

edge_cases.description: The loan's low initial payment assumes a tax credit is applied to principal, and the household has little or no tax liability
edge_cases.trigger: a retired or low-liability household routed into an incentive-dependent loan structure
edge_cases.mitigation: show both the initial and the re-amortized payment as the working assumption, route eligibility to the household's tax adviser before signature, and never state that the credit will be received

edge_cases.description: An association or historic-district rule restricting street-facing modules surfaces after the proposal is built
edge_cases.trigger: an aesthetic or approval restriction the household did not mention at survey
edge_cases.mitigation: re-survey the permitted planes, re-size and re-model on what is approvable, and add the approval stage to the timeline as an additional queue

edge_cases.description: The household intends to sell the home within a few years and is considering a lease or power-purchase agreement
edge_cases.trigger: a short expected tenure paired with a long third-party-ownership term
edge_cases.mitigation: walk the transfer-at-sale process, buyer qualification, buyout mechanism and any recorded filing before price, and require the household to restate the transfer rule in their own words

edge_cases.description: First-year production lands below the modeled central estimate and the household says the proposal misled them
edge_cases.trigger: a low-irradiance weather year, unexpected soiling, or an outage the household did not report
edge_cases.mitigation: reconcile from the ledger — inputs, dataset, loss assumptions and stated band — attribute the gap to a cause, and escalate to the installer where the cause is equipment or workmanship rather than weather

edge_cases.description: A competitor's proposal shows far larger savings and the household asks the seller to match it
edge_cases.trigger: a competing document built on blended rates, retail-valued exports or a compounding escalation assumption
edge_cases.mitigation: compare the two assumption sets line by line with the household rather than the two headline numbers, and decline to restate the model on assumptions that cannot be sourced even at the cost of the deal

workflow.action: Adopt the proposal-integrity charter and identify the obligation classes that apply
workflow.description: Write the permitted-source rule, the banned claim forms and the anti-pressure posture, and alongside it list the in-home solicitation, cancellation and disclosure obligation classes from CONSUMER_PROTECTION_FRAME with their authority and verification date
workflow.artifact: written proposal-integrity charter with a dated obligation-class register
workflow.gate: every claim type the proposal can contain has a permitted source, no guarantee language is allowed, and each obligation class names its authority and check date

workflow.description: Create the ledger and start capturing dated artifacts from the first contact: bills or data export, rate schedule, export-rules page, photographs
workflow.artifact: per-household evidence ledger with dated artifacts and source identifiers
workflow.gate: every artifact carries a capture date and an identifier, and no data category is held that no proposal line will use

workflow.action: Build the consumption baseline and interrogate forward load
workflow.description: Reconstruct twelve months of kilowatt-hours with time-of-use splits, resolve anomalies, then run the committed-versus-aspirational forward-load interview from LOAD_CHANGE_INTERROGATION
workflow.artifact: annotated consumption baseline with a committed-load adjustment and any aspirational sensitivity labelled
workflow.gate: twelve months present or the baseline labelled provisional everywhere, and only committed loads have moved the base case

workflow.action: Read the rate schedule and the export-compensation class
workflow.description: Identify the household's actual schedule and its fixed, minimum and non-bypassable components, then determine the export class that applies to a system interconnecting now under EXPORT_COMPENSATION_READ
workflow.artifact: tariff and export-rule summary with schedule identifiers and retrieval dates
workflow.gate: the schedule identifier, effective date and export class are in the ledger and displaceable energy is separated from charges that survive

workflow.action: Survey the roof planes and flag condition
workflow.description: Segment planes with azimuth, pitch and usable area after deductions, photograph the covering, and raise remaining-life and structural questions per ROOF_CONDITION_STRUCTURE
workflow.artifact: plane-by-plane survey with usable-area deductions, photographs and a roof-condition flag
workflow.gate: usable area is itemized rather than assumed, the survey is labelled subject to the installer's site audit, and any roof-life concern is written down

workflow.action: Quantify shade per plane and season
workflow.description: Measure or model shade for each candidate plane across seasons, record the method, and note foreseeable future shade
workflow.artifact: per-plane seasonal shade record with the method named
workflow.gate: no plane enters the production model without a shade input and a stated method, and future-shade risks are written into the proposal

workflow.description: Photograph and read the service equipment, capture busbar and breaker ratings, and form the early upgrade probability with its decision path
workflow.artifact: service screen with labelled photographs and a stated upgrade decision path
workflow.gate: panel label photographs are in the ledger and the possibility of an upgrade or alternative connection is disclosed with installer-sourced pricing

workflow.action: Model production with stated losses and a band
workflow.description: Run the model on the surveyed geometry, measured shade and the equipment the installer will fit, with named dataset and loss assumptions
workflow.artifact: modeled annual and monthly production with a band and a recorded input set
workflow.gate: the tool, version, dataset and every loss assumption are recorded, the output carries a band, and no guarantee language attaches to it

workflow.action: Resolve the sizing trade and name the binding constraint
workflow.description: Choose the offset target against consumption, usable area, export value, service capacity and budget, and record why larger and smaller were rejected
workflow.artifact: sizing decision record with the binding constraint and rejected alternatives
workflow.gate: the binding constraint is named in the proposal and surplus generation is valued at the applicable export class rather than at retail

workflow.action: Build the tariff-faithful bill comparison and the escalation cases
workflow.description: Reconstruct both sides of the bill under the real schedule and export class, retain surviving charges, include any financing payment, and add the zero-escalation and escalating cases from ESCALATOR_HONESTY
workflow.artifact: bill comparison model with an assumption page and separated first-year and lifetime figures
workflow.gate: charges that survive netting are still present, the financing payment is included, and no lifetime figure appears without its zero-escalation counterpart

workflow.action: Walk the financing classes and their disclosures before price
workflow.description: Teach ownership, incentive entitlement, obligation, maintenance, end-of-term and transfer for each class, then deliver the loan or third-party-ownership term walk-through and the incentive framing with its adviser referral
workflow.artifact: financing class comparison plus the completed disclosure walk-through record for the chosen class
workflow.gate: the class comparison preceded any price, both payment levels are shown on a step-structured loan, and the transfer-at-sale rule was covered with the agreement open

workflow.action: Assemble the pack and run the pre-signature audit
workflow.description: Build the ordered disclosure pack per PROPOSAL_ASSEMBLY_DISCLOSURE_PACK, then run the recorded audit covering traceability, modeled-not-promised language, escalation cases, comprehension restatement, site risks, incentives and cancellation rights
workflow.artifact: assembled disclosure pack and a recorded pre-signature audit with per-item pass or stop
workflow.gate: no unresolved stop item exists, the household has restated the payment obligation and transfer rule in their own words, and no pressure device was used

dominance_rules.rule: The permitted-source rule dominates any number that would make the deal look better
dominance_rules.rationale: an unsourced figure is the mechanism by which this vertical destroys its own reputation, and it is the only defect that cannot be repaired after install
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposal line cannot be traced to utility data, a published tariff or export rule, or a recorded model run
dominance_rules.action: delete the line or replace it with the sourced version, even where the sourced version is less attractive

dominance_rules.rule: Consumer-protection obligation classes dominate sales-process convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: the obligations exist precisely because in-home selling of long-duration obligations is where consumers are most exposed
dominance_rules.trigger: a required notice, cooling-off right or language-of-delivery obligation would slow or complicate the close
dominance_rules.action: comply with the obligation class as verified for the jurisdiction and adapt the process around it rather than the reverse

dominance_rules.rationale: a term the household cannot restate has not been disclosed in any meaningful sense, whatever the pack contains
dominance_rules.trigger: the household cannot restate the payment obligation, the escalator or the transfer-at-sale rule in their own words
dominance_rules.action: re-explain and re-test, and treat continued inability to restate as a stop rather than an objection to handle

dominance_rules.rule: The export-compensation class dominates roof capacity in the sizing decision
dominance_rules.rationale: what surplus generation is actually worth, not what fits, determines whether an increment of array benefits the household
dominance_rules.trigger: usable area would support a system larger than consumption plus committed load justifies under the applicable export class
dominance_rules.action: size to consumption and export value, and present any larger option separately with its surplus valued at the applicable export rate

dominance_rules.rule: The installer's engineering determination dominates the seller's field opinion
dominance_rules.rationale: structural, electrical and code judgements are licensed determinations and the seller carries neither the qualification nor the liability
dominance_rules.trigger: a structural, attachment, connection-method or code question arises during the survey or the appointment
dominance_rules.action: record the observation, escalate it to the installer in writing, and state the possibility to the household without asserting the determination

dominance_rules.rule: The household's own tax or financial adviser dominates the seller on any eligibility question
dominance_rules.rationale: incentive eligibility and product suitability are personal advice the seller is not positioned or permitted to give
dominance_rules.trigger: the household asks whether they will receive a credit, how much, or which financing class is better for them
dominance_rules.action: explain the mechanism and the class, name the publishing authority, and route the eligibility or suitability question to their adviser with the routing recorded

dominance_rules.rule: A modeled figure with a band dominates a single confident number
dominance_rules.rationale: production and savings are model outputs whose inputs carry real uncertainty, and a point estimate invites the household to hear a floor
dominance_rules.trigger: any production or savings figure is about to be presented, spoken or written
dominance_rules.action: present the central estimate with its band and its assumptions, and attribute any genuine guarantee to the party that issued it in writing

dominance_rules.rule: Walking away dominates a signature obtainable only under pressure
dominance_rules.rationale: a pressured signature converts into a cancellation, a clawback and a story that costs more pipeline than the deal was worth
dominance_rules.trigger: the deal can only be closed by an expiring offer, an unaccompanied vulnerable homeowner, or an improvised translation
dominance_rules.action: stop, leave the materials, offer to return with the right people present, and accept the loss

dominance_rules.rule: The zero-escalation case dominates as the reference scenario whenever escalation is shown
dominance_rules.rationale: escalation assumptions are unverifiable forecasts that can manufacture any lifetime figure a seller wants
dominance_rules.trigger: a lifetime savings figure or an escalating agreement is presented
dominance_rules.action: show the zero-escalation case beside it, name the source of any escalation assumption, and keep the first-year tariff-faithful figure as the headline

anti_rework_rules.rule: Collect twelve months of usage and the rate-schedule identifier before running any production or savings model
anti_rework_rules.prevents: modeling, sizing and quoting an entire proposal on a baseline that has to be rebuilt when the real history arrives

anti_rework_rules.rule: Determine the export-compensation class before choosing an offset target
anti_rework_rules.prevents: sizing an array whose surplus is worth far less than assumed, then re-sizing, re-modeling and re-quoting after the household questions it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Photograph the service panel and its rating label on the first visit
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a service-upgrade surprise at the installer's site audit that turns a signed deal into a change order and a trust problem

anti_rework_rules.rule: Quantify shade per plane before any production number is spoken aloud
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a spoken estimate that anchors the household and cannot be walked back once measurement lowers it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Raise roof remaining life before financing documents are prepared
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a re-roof decision arriving after a loan or agreement is documented, forcing rescission, re-application or an expensive later removal and reinstallation

anti_rework_rules.rule: Identify the jurisdiction's obligation classes before the proposal template is built
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding every pack and re-contacting signed households when a required notice or delivery rule is discovered late

anti_rework_rules.rule: Walk the financing class and its disclosures before presenting price
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a household anchored on a monthly payment discovering the ownership, escalator and transfer terms afterwards and cancelling

anti_rework_rules.rule: Put the assumption page beside the savings figure in the first version of the document
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the rework of re-issuing proposals and re-explaining numbers once a household or their adult child asks what the figure was built on

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm all title-holders and decision-makers before the presentation appointment is booked
anti_rework_rules.prevents: presenting twice, or worse obtaining a signature from someone without authority that must later be unwound

iteration_protocol.trigger: the utility changes the rate schedule or the export-compensation class while a proposal is open
iteration_protocol.action: re-read the schedule and export class, rebuild the comparison, re-issue the proposal explaining what changed, and reset any signature that was pending on the old numbers

iteration_protocol.trigger: the household commits to a load change after the baseline was fixed
iteration_protocol.action: move the committed load into the base case, re-size, re-model production and savings, and re-issue rather than annotate

iteration_protocol.trigger: the installer's site audit returns different usable area, shade or service conditions
iteration_protocol.action: correct the survey inputs, re-model, re-issue the proposal with the corrected scope and price, and re-walk any disclosure the change affects

iteration_protocol.trigger: first-year production or bills diverge materially from the model
iteration_protocol.action: reconcile line by line from the evidence ledger, attribute the gap, escalate equipment or workmanship causes to the installer, and retune the loss and shade assumptions used for future proposals

iteration_protocol.trigger: the household cannot restate a core obligation in their own words at the gate
iteration_protocol.action: stop the signature, re-explain the term, arrange an interpreter or a trusted third party if needed, and re-run the gate at a later visit

iteration_protocol.trigger: an incentive program changes its rules, funding or deadlines, or closes
iteration_protocol.action: strip the affected assumption out of every open proposal, re-issue with the conditional line updated and the authority re-cited, and re-check any loan structure that presumed it

iteration_protocol.trigger: permit, interconnection or inspection queues in the territory lengthen or the process changes
iteration_protocol.action: update the staged ranges and the named blocking stage in the pack, and notify households with open proposals whose timeline language is now stale

iteration_protocol.trigger: a complaint, cancellation or dispute traces back to a claim made in a proposal
iteration_protocol.action: audit the charter and the pack template against the claim that failed, add or tighten the gate item that should have caught it, and re-check open proposals for the same defect

priority_rationale: The charter, the obligation-class frame and the evidence ledger come first because they decide what any later number is allowed to be and how it must be provable; the household's own inputs — consumption baseline, forward load, rate schedule, export class, roof planes, shade, roof condition and service equipment — come next because every model output inherits their error; production modeling, sizing and the tariff-faithful bill comparison sit on top of those inputs and cannot be honest without them; the financing classes and their disclosures follow a fixed system scope so the household compares structures rather than moving targets; and the disclosure pack and the pre-signature audit come last because they compose everything upstream into the artifact the household keeps and the single stop-on-fail check that makes the rest of the subdomain real.
